BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Demonic Quasar!!
There's nothing in particular...So let's go...
W-what's that?!
It's a low-class creature of another world.\nIt's my first time seeing it.\nJust for your information, it's called Quasar.
Quasar?! Is it Coenubia's friends?!
Coenubia...What's that?
I came from another dimension...\nLow-class creatures like you will never\nunderstand...
Although the form and shape are different, it\nsomehow reminds you of Nurethoth that appeared at\nthe Gate of Another World...
So you're the one who was messing with\nthis place, huh?!
Indeed! I managed to change the environment of\nthis place so that it's comfortable for myself\nwith the poison I emit.
This place will be my first base and I'm going to\nstart working on other places as well!
Stop kidding me!\nDo you think we'll just let you do what you want?\nDream on!!
Living beings are not only those who live in this\nworld. Just remember there are species that are\nsuperior to you out there...
It's a relief that we were able to stop this world\nfrom getting invaded, but we never know when\ncreatures like Quasar will show up again...
What are we gonna do with this place?\nIt seems heavily polluted by the poison...
Let's just leave it for now.\nWind and rain may wash the poison away.
If not, then we may want to ask those in Einklang\nfor help or even the Resistle researchers to find\na way to get rid of the poison...
I guess that's the only thing we can do...\nAlright, let's head back to Hora Diomedea then!
Okay, let's go!
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing! Let's get out!
Explore here a little longer!
